title: Press Release
overview: This page stores NPGC media and events information for Press Release. Captured source headings include: Press Release, About, Quick Links, External Links. Source page: https://www.npgc.in/PressRelease.aspx
content:
16 Sep 2017 - One Day Workshop on GST by Deen Dayal Upadhayay KAUSHAL Kendra -Hindi
16 Sep 2017 - One Day Workshop on GST by Deen Dayal Upadhayay KAUSHAL Kendra -English
26 Aug 2017 - Blood Donation Camp organised by Lions Club Lucknow and NSS Unit of the College jointly
28 Mar 2017 - दो दिवसीय नेशनल सेमिनार
27 Mar 2017 - Workshop in Goods and Service Tax (GST) by Commerce Department
04 Mar 2017 - Geo-Fest 2017 being organised by Department of Geography, National Post Graduate College
03 Mar 2017 - Azim Premji Foundation organized a Campus Selection test for Post Graduate students in Geography Department
01 Mar 2017 - One Day Special Program on Stress Management
22 Feb 2017 - नेशनल पी.जी. कॉलेज के रोवर्स / रेन्जर्स ने सर्व धर्मं प्रार्थना सभा में भाग लेकर स्काउट-गाइड दस संस्थापक लार्ड बेडेन पॉवेल के जन्म दिवस को चिंतन दिवस के रूप में मनाया
30 Jan 2017 - Health Awareness Camp by NIPCCD
23 Jan 2017 - Eye check-up Camp in College Campus
23 Dec 2016 - Declaration of Results for Examination Session Dec-2016
16 Dec 2016 - Workshop on Cashless Transaction in Day to Day Life
14 Dec 2016 - Free Claseses for preparation of NET / JRF - JAN 2017 by Department of Geography
12 Nov 2016 - Press note on Principal become Vice Chancellor
04 Nov 2016 - Debate Competition on Corruption Organised by National Insurance Corporation Ltd.
27 Oct 2016 - Department of Geography, National P.G. College, Lucknow, under “GEO HELP” program is going to organize a Drawing Competition in the college campus to motivate under privileged children living in the slum.
04 Oct 2016 - Intimation regarding Motivational Lecture on ‘Memory Management’ at National PG College, Lucknow
02 Oct 2016 - National Seminar organised by Gandhi Study Center on "Gandhi Today"
16 Sep 2016 - Free guidance classes for preparation of competitive examination related to discipline Geography for Assistant Professor, PGT, Navodaya Vidhyalaya and related examinations.
22 Aug 2016 - THE TIRANGA YATRA.
13 Aug 2016 - Blood Donation Camp
22 Jun 2016 - Admission in IGNOU Study Centre at Zero Fees for SC/ST Candidates
02 Jun 2016 - Free Claseses for preparation of NET / JRF - 2016 by Department of Geography
30 May 2016 - Faculty Development Program
17 May 2016 - Examination Result June-2016
22 Apr 2016 - College has been granted the status of CPE (College with Potential for Excellence) by the University Grants Commission.
